name: Katrina Morgan
source:
One of  [url=https://vndb.org/c174069]John[/url]'s close friends since the beginning of high school. Although she was without friends at the time, she now regularly hangs out with John's circle as well as her D&D group. She's very fun-loving and likes to joke around, but sometimes her jokes go a little too far. She seems to really dislike  [url=https://vndb.org/c174079]Sayaka [/url] for some reason.
